page is built, so it always matches the released binary.

```{bash}
scx --version
```

```{bash}
scx --help
```

## Internal tooling

`snapshot` dumps SCX's internal representation of a file as a directory of
NPY arrays. `scx convert` can read the snapshot back, which isolates write
cost from read cost in benchmarks. It is not a format to exchange data in.

```{bash}
scx snapshot --help
```
